description: This PHP class, 'CalendarEventConflictResolver', manages conflict resolution strategies when synchronizing calendar events between internal and external sources. It includes methods for determining which event version should be used during sync, based on timestamps, event origin, and conflict resolution strategies. The class also validates event data for security and integrity, such as timestamp ranges and suspicious content.

classes.name: CalendarEventConflictResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving conflicts between calendar events during synchronization, based on predefined strategies, timestamps, and event origins.

methods.name: determineWinningEvent
methods.description: Determines which of the two calendar events should be used during sync, based on modification status and conflict resolution strategy.

methods.name: validateEventData
methods.description: Validates the event data for security issues, such as timestamp range and suspicious content patterns.

methods.name: determineEarlySelection
methods.description: Checks if an early decision can be made when both events are identical, avoiding conflict resolution.

methods.name: resolveByTimestamp
methods.description: Resolves conflicts by selecting the event with the most recent modification timestamp, with microsecond precision.

methods.name: resolveByExternalPriority
methods.description: Prefers the external event during conflict resolution; falls back to timestamp if statuses are equal.

methods.name: resolveByInternalPriority
methods.description: Prefers the internal event during conflict resolution; falls back to timestamp if statuses are equal.
